title: ajania myriantha
intro: Ajania myriantha, commonly known as Chinese chamomile or White Aster, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to calm the mind, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic properties, which may help soothe digestive issues and alleviate symptoms of insomnia and restlessness. The bioactive constituents of Ajania myriantha include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
